c_avi_weight_policy: Actual in-season production remains at 40% of C-AVI, forward projections at 25%, public market at 15%, league context at 10%, and demonstrated elite upside at 10%. Observed-game reliability and injury availability are applied separately.
d_avi_missing_component_policy: Redistribute missing optional component weights proportionally across verified components.

in_season_transition.activation_policy: Use every verified completed 2026 week. If FantasyPros has begun publishing an incomplete current week, ignore that partial week rather than reverting C-AVI to preseason values.

injury_availability_adjustments.policy: Bounded ongoing injury-risk deduction for currently designated players (including verified missed games beyond one bye), followed by a hard ceiling for expected missed future games; cleared players receive no historical-injury discount.

injury_rebound_policy: Bounded credit for verified current injuries with missed games and established healthy ceiling; never applied to healthy underperformers or unproven upside.

production_component_policy.player_points: Ranked PPR points/game and season points, with up to 25% recent-four-game lower-half consistency adjustment; small samples receive reduced consistency weight
production_component_policy.weekly_ceiling: best completed-week PPR rank within the same fantasy-relevant positional pool
